Name: Razolyn the Magnificent - Furry Anthro Overhaul (Unofficial)
Author: 1337DragonWolf
Description:
Being the strange individual that I am, I found it boring to have all humans in the valley, so I jovially downloaded [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued - (Furry Overhaul Mod) Plus Genderswaps[/url]﻿. After a while, I decided to look into more mods for the game, until I came across and quickly fell in love with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2898]Razolyn the Magnificent - Now Marriageable- Wizard Replacement[/url]﻿. However, I very quickly realized that if I were to download and add Razolyn the Magnificent to my game, she'd be the only human, so I spent a couple of hours editing the images to make her into an anthro.

She's a green dragon, in the same vein as the Wizard in the furry overhaul. Her cloak hides her wings and tail, which will only be seen when she's wearing her wedding dress. Her hair hides her frilled ears in her portraits. Yes, her ventral scales are cream, and if you don't like that, you can die mad about it.

I did not have a good reference to match Razolyn's portrait design to match the furry overhaul mod's artist's style. It is more of a recoloring/slight editing of ParadigmNomad's images, so I'm sorry if it still feels a little out of place.

Keep in mind, this is not official. Perhaps one day, the various contributors to the furry overhaul mod will make an image for her. In the meantime, if you use both mods, and want her to be a dragon and fit in, or if you just want her to be a dragon to break the mold, I'm giving you what I made.

I hope you enjoy.

[color=#00ff00][size=6]HOW TO INSTALL:
[/size][/color]1. Download the above mentioned mods and their requirements. Make sure they work. Anthro Characters isn't required, but Razolyn the Magnificent is. I will list only Razolyn the Magnificent in the requirements.

2. Download my mod.

3. Extract the images somewhere you can easily find them.

4. Find the directory where the original images are. For Steam users, the default is:  (C:)/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods/[CP]Razolyn/assets

5. Make sure you have a copy of the original images, in case you change your mind.

6. Drag the two images into the directory. Overwrite.

7. Enjoy your magical dragon waifu.
